## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck + lint + tests)
- [ ] Added or updated a test
- [ ] UI change: screenshot below
- [ ] Slicing/printing change: tried on (practice printer / mock / real printer model):
- [ ] Agent behaviour change: ran `npm run eval` (costs tokens) or explained why not

## Safety and licences

- [ ] Doesn't weaken the print confirm dialog, slice review, agent sandbox or printer preflight (or explains why below)
- [ ] No real printer is contacted by tests or scripts
- [ ] New dependency or vendored file: licence is permissive, `npm run notices` re-run, docs/licenses/INVENTORY.md updated
- [ ] No personal data (keys, printer serials/IPs, home paths, transcripts, family projects)
